title: Te Whakawhirinakitanga Tuatahi i Pakaru i Pararaiha
intro: Whakaarohia te tū i roto i tētahi māra o te rangimārie tino pai, e whakahonoretia ana i runga ake i ngā mea hanga katoa, me te rohe kotahi anake hei whakaute. He kōrero mā te hāhā mō te mutunga kore, he kōwhiringa kotahi e whakarerekē ana i ngā mea katoa, engari ko te aroha e whakatuwhera ana i te ara hoki. Ko wai e kōrero mai i te tīmatanga o te tangata?
clues: I hangaia ahau e Allah i te paru, ā, i whakaahuatia ahau me te atawhai Atua.
I whakahonoretia ahau i te wā i whakahau ai a Allah i ngā anahera kia piko ki ahau.
I noho māua ko taku hoa rangatira ki Pararaiha, e wātea ana māua ki te kai i ngā mea katoa engari kotahi te rākau.
I tinihangatia ahau e te kōrero hāhā a Hātana, i oati nei he kaitohutohu pono ia.
I kai ahau i te hua o te rākau tapu, ā, i tangohia atu tōku hipoki i te whakama.
I ako ahau i ngā kupu ripeneta mai i tōku Ariki, ā, ka tahuri mai a Allah ki ahau me te aroha.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Jalut (Koriata)
Dhul-Kifli
Namrud
Poropiti Arama
Poropiti a Yahya

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I whakakahore ki te tomo ki te Whenua Tapu i te wehi
I tono kia karakiatia te ahi hei atua
I patua e ia tōna teina i te hae mō te whakahere
I kai i te hua o te rākau tapu i muri i te hāhā a Hātana
I tautohetia me karakia ngā whakapakoko o ngā tūpuna
trial.answer: I kai i te hua o te rākau tapu i muri i te hāhā a Hātana

Pararaiha (Jannah)

outcome.label: Hua
options: I toremi ahau i roto i te waipuke nui me te hunga whakaponokore
I whakaakona ahau e Allah ki ngā kupu o te ripeneta, ā, i murua hoki e ia ōku hara
I pāngia ahau e te uira i taku tono kia kite i a Allah
I horomia ahau e te ika nui mō taku wehenga atu me te riri
I puta ke ahau me tōku iwi mō te takahi i te Hāpati
outcome.answer: I whakaakona ahau e Allah ki ngā kupu o te ripeneta, ā, i murua hoki e ia ōku hara

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
